description_en: This operation returns the time ranges available for restoring data from a backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于查看一个备份计划可恢复时间段详情
name: DescribeRestoreRangeInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to get this value
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the restorable time range
parameters.help_zh: 查询可恢复开始时间，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: begin_timestamp_for_restore

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the restorable time range
parameters.help_zh: 查询可恢复结束时间，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: end_timestamp_for_restore

parameters.help_en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable recent restore
parameters.name: recently_restore
